notes.title: Patch: 0.2.3 Alpha
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]


- Fixed an Audio issue that caused the music and Narration in the introductory cut-scene to randomly restart mid-scene.

- Fixed SFX Looping error in all world transition cut-scenes.

- Removed buggy arrows from Lvl.1

- Fixed a visibility issue with the Lvl.2 Electric Platforms which caused them to barely visible while active.


[h3]Additions:[/h3]


- Added Narrator to transition scenes for both level 1 and 2

- Added user stat tracking.

- Added Achievement System ( Steam Achievements still not functional.)

- Added T.O.S.S. Minigame Theme music, "Ro-Bop", Courtesy of Michael Electric.



[h3]Visual Changes:[/h3]


- Updated Player Ship sprite for all world transition cut-scenes.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.2 Alpha
notes.content: This patch adds a couple of QOL enhancements to include a crude checkpoint system, half jump and m the plasma nozzles are now more visible when they are inactive.

notes.title: Major Patch 0.2.0 Alpha
notes.content:
[h1][u][b]The Following Changes Have Been Made:[/b][/u][/h1]


[h3][u][b]Visual Updates:[/b][/u][/h3]

- The Entire Look of Qubie has changed to a space theme and Qubie is now known as the invader of worlds.

- Added space elements as well as Neon elements.

- added several particle effects and other small visual enhancements.

- Qubie changes colors, A lot.


[h3][u][b]Gameplay Changes:[/b][/u][/h3]

- Added Elements from the O.G. Qubie prototype such as arrows and boulder traps.

- Added various other Traps to liven up the game and produce a more rage-inducing experience.

- Added a special mechanic that you will have to discover for yourself...

- Removed Qubies AK-47 and reverted back to only having the bounce attack.

- added a sneak mechanic, some enemies cannot hurt you if they are not facing you.

- Added a separate tutorial level so that players can familiarize themselves with the controls before jumping into the chaos.

- Added a minigame to break up the rage a bit.


[h3][u][b]Audio Changes:[/b][/u][/h3]

- All new music and a hidden full song (over 5 minutes long)

- maybe some hidden RNG sound effects...
